explication: CCO is a suite of mid-level ontologies that provides reusable classes and relations grounded in BFO. Its principal workflow is ontology development and use: users import the ontology modules or merged release into ontology tools, then use the shared terms in datasets; per-IRI files support term resolution. The repository also maintains extensions, including the Modal Relation Ontology. The README documents the merge and major ontology scopes; sampled scripts show IRI-file generation and MRO processing details, but not their complete orchestration.
